title: Hallow Woods
body:
“Some say the forests can be very dark and scary... others decide to embrace it.”

Description


The Hallow Woods Vinyl is a record that you can buy at the Ghoulish Goods store from October 7th to October 31st of 2023 for 🍬6,660 Candy, it can be put into a Blue Vinyl Player to make it play music.

Trivia

  • This is one of the first event orientated Vinyls.
  • This is one of the first Vinyls to not cost Dollars but Candy.
  • This is one of the first Vinyls to cause an in-game environmental effect of fog when played.
  • This vinyl was made by the player the_overtimegamer
